name: Postgres MCP Pro
description: Connects agents to Postgres over MCP with configurable read or write access plus index tuning, EXPLAIN plan analysis and database health checks.

skills.name: SQL Execution
skills.description: Runs queries against Postgres in restricted or unrestricted mode, returning typed result sets to the agent.

skills.name: Index Tuning
skills.description: Analyzes workloads and recommends indexes with estimated benefit, using industrial tuning algorithms.

skills.name: Database Health Checks
skills.description: Inspects buffer cache, vacuum state, connection load and bloat to report actionable health problems.
